a.v: An expense claim covers a cost you pay on someone else's behalf. You spend your own money on something the guild is going to pay for, and you are reimbursed afterwards.

items.q: Do I always get my money back?

a.v: No, reimbursement is not automatic. You are entitled to it when both of these are true:

v: Your committee chair approved the purchase.
You can support the purchase with a valid receipt.

a.v: ALWAYS check with your committee chair before making a purchase. If the requirements are not met, you risk having to pay for it yourself.

items.q: What should I do before I buy anything?

v: Clear the purchase with your committee chair and get an approval.
Make sure you get a valid receipt at the register, not just an order confirmation or a card slip.
Report the purchase here on the site as soon as you get home.
